reviewers.summary: The added observers cover @react-three/fiber loading and model asset requests, but the test preloads the Hangar entry controller itself, leaving the regular-mode no-Hangar-module criterion unverified.

findingList.message: The lazy-loading test still cannot detect a Hangar controller import during regular-mode startup. Isolate and observe App's production import path so the test fails if that module is loaded before Hangar selection.

evidence.codePathTraced: The test imports entryController at module scope before resetting its only module-load counter, which observes @react-three/fiber. The production Hangar controller import itself is not observed.
evidence.failureScenario: If App changes to import ./hangar/entryController at startup, the test's own import has already loaded that module, so the counter remains unchanged and the test passes despite a Hangar module being imported in regular mode.

reviewers.summary: The added instrumentation checks imports and model requests after the test starts, but resetting the counter after App is imported leaves the regular-mode eager-import criterion unverified.

findingList.message: The lazy-loading test can miss a Hangar module imported while App is loaded: it resets the import counter after the module-scope App import. Instrument before importing App so the test detects eager startup imports.

evidence.codePathTraced: The test imports App at module scope, then resets the @react-three/fiber import counter inside the test. The mock factory can run while App is imported, before that reset; the fetch spy is also installed only afterward.
evidence.failureScenario: If App statically imports the Hangar rendering module during startup, the mock counter increments before the test resets it. The test then observes zero and passes, so the regular-mode no-import criterion is not verified.

reviewers.summary: The new counter and asset-request spy improve coverage, but resetting the counter after importing the Hangar controller leaves the prior lazy-loading test finding unresolved.

findingList.message: The lazy-loading test still misses eager Hangar imports: its module-level controller import can trigger them before the test resets the import counter.

evidence.codePathTraced: The test imports `entryController` at module scope, then resets the `@react-three/fiber` import counter immediately before rendering App. That erases evidence of any eager Fiber import triggered while the test imported the controller; the test also cannot distinguish an eager App import because the controller is already loaded.
evidence.failureScenario: If `entryController` eagerly imports `@react-three/fiber`, the mock counter increments before this test and is reset to zero at line 60. The startup assertions then pass even though the Hangar module loaded before selection, so the lazy-loading criterion remains unverified.
